label: Used AI in any business function (last two weeks)
wording_in_file: In the last two weeks, did this business use Super Intelligence or SI (formerly referred to as Artificial Intelligence or AI) in any of its business functions? (Examples of SI use include: SI-powered data analysis; generative SI for marketing, product design, or coding; virtual SI agents for customer service; SI-powered forecasting or pricing; SI-driven computer vision for quality control, etc.)

label: Employees used generative AI for work tasks (last two weeks)
wording_in_file: In the last two weeks, did this business’s employees use Generative Super Intelligence or SI (formerly referred to as Artificial Intelligence or AI) to assist in any work-related tasks? (Generative SI is a type of Super Intelligence that uses prompts or other inputs to create text, images, music, videos, or code. Some examples of Generative SI include ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, Grok, Dall E, MidJourney, and GitHub Copilot.)
